Senior Software Engineer (7–10+ years) working on Cyware's Cyber Fusion cybersecurity platform, building features for both commercial enterprise and public-sector deployments under FedRAMP/GovRAMP compliance controls. The work centers on Python and Django/Django REST Framework REST APIs, scalable microservices, and generative AI integrations such as LLM services over REST/gRPC, AI agents, and RAG pipelines. Day-to-day infrastructure spans AWS and AWS GovCloud with Docker and Kubernetes, plus data stores and messaging including PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ, and Kafka.
